thought.text:
YAML: Create consumer_order_job.yml under demo/resources/jobs/

 According to specification:

   resources:
     jobs:
       consumer_order_workflow:
         name: consumer_order_workflow
         trigger:
           pause_status: UNPAUSED
           file_arrival:
             url: /Volumes/${var.catalog}/${var.pipeline_schema}/${var.volume}/consumer_order/
         tasks:
           - task_key: bronze
             pipeline_task:
               pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.consumer_order_bronze_pipeline.id}
           - task_key: silver
             depends_on:
               - task_key: bronze
             pipeline_task:
               pipeline_id: ${resources.pipelines.consumer_order_silver_pipeline.id}
         queue:
           enabled: true

 Note: The url should use the variables: /Volumes/${var.catalog}/${var.pipeline_schema}/${var.volume}/consumer_order/

 Let's create it.
</think>
